answer: Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, burned when the recruit misbehaves, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Reaching the vertex of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Every claim climbs the whisper of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the lotus re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
